03 / Twitch title

Current features use title updates and own-channel clip downloads, with broader broadcast and clip management access. Future permissions, not active features: read/send chat; read followers, subscriptions, and cheers; read/manage rewards; create clips; bot use. Requesting unused permissions conflicts with Twitch policy and risks API access suspension. Consent does not authorize a separate bot account. Existing grants are retained. Consent performs no channel action. Review the exact title and approve it separately before applying.
